kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نمتهن (form VIII)
# نَمْتَهِنُ (namtahinu) /nam.ta.hi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# نَمْتَهِنَ (namtahina) /nam.ta.hi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# نَمْتَهِنْ (namtahin) /nam.ta.hin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
